step1_analysis.circuit_type: Dual Adaptive Regulated Cascode Photoreceptor (Logarithmic Transimpedance Amplifier)
step1_analysis.description: An analog VLSI circuit that converts photocurrents into logarithmic voltages. It uses regulated cascodes to pin the photodiode voltages, improving bandwidth at low light levels. The left and right halves use different amplifier topologies (NMOS source follower vs PMOS current mirror) to regulate the input nodes.

paper_reference.title: An ASIC for Hartmann–Shack Wavefront Detection

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption at 1nA input current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Right side consumes 2nA (1nA input + 1nA mirror). Left side consumes 1nA input + ~50nA for the NMOS amplifier. Total current ~52nA at 1.8V.
Bandwidth is limited by the output PMOS diode impedance and the 2.3pF load capacitance.
Small-signal resistance of the diode-connected PMOS at 1nA is roughly 36 MΩ.

log_slope.description: Output voltage change for a decade change in input current (1nA to 10nA).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Subthreshold slope of the PMOS diode determines the logarithmic conversion factor.

input_voltage.description: Regulated DC voltage at the input nodes (N2, N3).

sky130_expected.reasoning: The regulated cascode pins the input node to a voltage near the threshold of the amplifier NMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power, bandwidth, transimpedance gain, and logarithmic slope of the dual photoreceptor.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dual Regulated Cascode Photoreceptor Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N5 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VDD N1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Iin_left N2 0 DC 1n AC 1 PULSE(1n 10n 10m 1m 1m 40m 100m)
Iin_right N3 0 DC 1n AC 1 PULSE(1n 10n 10m 1m 1m 40m 100m)

Cload_left N1 0 2.3p
Cload_right N0 0 2.3p

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N1) v(N0) v(N2) v(N3)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 10 0.1 1Meg
let gain_left = vdb(N1)
let gain_right = vdb(N0)
meas ac dc_gain_left find gain_left at=1
meas ac dc_gain_right find gain_right at=1
meas ac bw_left when gain_left='dc_gain_left - 3' fall=1
meas ac bw_right when gain_right='dc_gain_right - 3' fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Log Slope
tran 100u 100m
meas tran v1_base find v(N1) at=5m
meas tran v1_pulse find v(N1) at=30m
let log_slope_left = v1_base - v1_pulse
print log_slope_left

meas tran v0_base find v(N0) at=5m
meas tran v0_pulse find v(N0) at=30m
let log_slope_right = v0_base - v0_pulse
print log_slope_right

quit
.endc
